title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects open questions and answers them with web search
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly reports that Facilitator availability has no documented automation, although Microsoft documents PowerShell for app-centric management. The web-search control also combines steps from two pages under a link that does not document the complete path, and the retention caveat overlooks Microsoft's coverage of Facilitator meeting interactions.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans for Facilitator to detect unanswered questions in Teams meetings and offer web-search help.
claims.quote: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes an unanswered question followed by an offer that participants can accept by selecting Yes.
claims.quote: Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.
